//: Set-local type map of set miri (lane miri-contract, plan-m6 D2; types.sets.json `typemap_extra`, after tyir, middle_traits_thir,
infer and mir). Miri's modules `use crate::*;`, and lib.rs re-exports `rustc_const_eval::interpret::*` by a glob the generator
does not follow, so the interpreter names reached that way are mapped as `miri::X` here.
u64/i64 are `bigint` in this set (decision miri-contract C5): Miri's u64 values are addresses, sizes and values written to
program memory (base addresses, eventfd counters, epoll data, inode numbers), the interpreter's own convention
(interp-contract: u64 interpreter values are bigints). `BorTag` is a hand branded number (one per retag; < 2^53).
The interpreter value types (`ImmTy`, `OpTy`, `PlaceTy`, `MPlaceTy`, `FnArg`, `Frame`, `Pointer`, `Scalar`) carry their
provenance parameter (lane interp-generic, plan-m6 D3; reconciled by lane interp-miri-reconcile): `ImmTy<$0>` with
Host-only paths (isolation off, D14), measureme profiling and crates.io deps not vendored yet are `never` (a field that is
always `None` / a variant never built on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu) or `Pending<..>` placeholders with the lane that replaces them.

fields.//: decision miri-contract C5 amendment (lane interp-miri-reconcile): four hot u64/u128 fields are `number` (values provably < 2^53; each has a PORT note in its hand module)
